svg.aria-label: Journey. 2021 to 2025: B.Sc. in Computer Science at BRAC University, CGPA 3.72, Vice Chancellor's List twice and Dean's List twice. January to September 2024: undergraduate teaching assistant for Complex Variables and Laplace Transformation, 120 plus students per semester. 2024 to now: course projects (YOLOv8 signboards, RSWNet, Nilam BD) and RejBoard, a hobby project. Next chapter: MS in computer science, fall 2027, computer vision and medical imaging.
